multinomial_fixed_launch.covariance: C = blockdiag( A^{-1} M A^{-1} / N ),  M = diag(p) - p p^T,  p_i = A_i R_i within each wavelength block
multinomial_fixed_launch.whitening: W = blockdiag( sqrt(N) M^{-1/2} A ), the same construction as src/unify.whiten_multinomial

singular_direction.why_not: M is positive definite whenever the total detection probability is strictly below 1 and no cell has zero probability. Both hold at the production operating point, so there is no exactly singular direction to project out and no pseudo-inverse is needed.
singular_direction.consequence: M^{-1/2} amplifies the near-null direction by the square root of the condition number, up to about 1.24e+04. That direction is spanned by the low-count outer bins, so the multinomial whitening is far more sensitive to them than the diagonal Poisson one. Any frozen design must state which of the two it uses and must report this conditioning, because it is the dominant numerical risk.
singular_direction.treatment_if_a_future_operating_point_is: project onto the complement of the null space within each wavelength block and record the projector in the spec. Not required here, and deliberately not implemented, so that it cannot be applied silently.

t_definition.why_not_calibrated: the component j quoted in the memo is argmax over components of the whitened standardized discrepancy, so it is SELECTED by the same data that supplies its t. The marginal null distribution of a t at a selected index is not Student's t, and the selection inflates it. This number says the discrepancy at that index is not visibly noise; it does not supply coverage and is not used in any bound.
t_definition.what_would_be_needed: either an index fixed before the data, or sample splitting with the index chosen on one half and the t computed on the other, or an independent confirmatory run. A confirmatory design must do one of these.

what_each_bounds.norm_of_the_mean: the norm of the mean derivative bias PLUS a noise floor of tr(Sigma_W)/n. It is an upper-biased estimate of the bias.
what_each_bounds.mean_of_the_norms: the mean norm of noisy replicate differences. It contains Monte Carlo noise even when the derivative bias is exactly zero, and averaging more replicates does not remove it. It must not be used as an equivalence numerator.
what_each_bounds.bias_corrected: a TRUNCATED BIAS-CORRECTED POINT ESTIMATE of the norm of the mean derivative bias. Subtracting an estimated trace does not produce a confidence bound, and a value of zero means only that the point estimate is zero. It is not evidence of equivalence, it carries no confidence statement, and NO valid upper bound exists to supply one: the resampling heuristic that was tried is refuted by the committed Bernoulli counterexample.
what_each_bounds.projection_onto_fixed_directions: not used here. A projection would be confirmatory only onto directions fixed before the data; data-selected directions give no coverage.

4_dual_requirement_diagonal_poisson.aggregate_statistic: || W dbar || / || W e2bar ||, with the denominator estimated from the same replicates. The accompanying heuristic upper value is NOT a confidence bound; see candidate2_statistic and the Bernoulli counterexample. The trace-subtracted quantity is a point estimate only.
4_dual_requirement_diagonal_poisson.component_statistic: max_j |dbar_j| / sqrt(C_jj), in PHYSICAL BIN coordinates
4_dual_requirement_diagonal_poisson.why_not_the_whitened_coordinate_maximum: for a block-dense whitening, (W dbar)_j mixes bins and is not observable j in noise units. Its maximum moves under an orthogonal rotation of the whitening square root, which leaves the aggregate norm and the covariance unchanged, so it would be an artefact of an arbitrary basis.
4_dual_requirement_diagonal_poisson.component_statistic_is_not_divided_by_th: a component whose derivative is near zero cannot inflate this, which is the failure mode of the raw relative statistic

fisher_relation.what_the_aggregate_margin_controls: the same-column Fisher diagonal, relatively, at 2 eps + eps^2; the off-diagonal entries only in absolute terms
fisher_relation.what_neither_margin_controls: Schur complements, eigenvalues, CRLB values and every downstream classification. These depend on the principal angle between the nuisance and physiological column spaces, not on column size, and a committed counterexample shows a column-level margin cannot close that gap.

verdict.reading: the h^2 coefficient is identified on a majority of retained components for 1 of 5 columns (log_mus_scale) and NOT for 4 (log_d_epidermis, log_d_papillary, log_d_reticular, mus_slope), where the identified fraction is log_d_epidermis 7.5 percent, log_d_papillary 10.8 percent, log_d_reticular 20.0 percent, mus_slope 10.0 percent. A revised step grid therefore cannot be argued from this pilot for the columns that matter most, the three thicknesses, and a separate pilot designed to separate h^2 from h^4 is required. 6_effective_counts.definition: n_i = N * A_i * R_i, with A_i and R_i from the committed pooled artifact

reproduces_min_count_5.why_this_matters: an independent check that this calculation matches the recorded P2 legacy MIN_COUNT=5 behaviour, which drops 54 of 120 bins and moves the P2 legacy deep bound from 1.9128 to 2.4225, a 26.6 percent change

implications.approximate_normality_of_the_transport_d: the transport estimator averages 200,000 photons per wavelength, so its own central limit behaviour is governed by how many of them reach a given bin, not by the nominal count. In a bin whose production expectation is below one photon the transport estimate is a sum over a handful of weighted contributions, so per-component approximate normality is not credible there and the registered coverage assumption is weakest exactly where the raw relative statistic is largest.
implications.production_multinomial_fisher_calculatio: these bins are the near-null direction of M within each wavelength block. The worst block condition number is 1.54e+08, so M^{-1/2} amplifies them by about 1.24e+04. The published Fisher calculation therefore already depends on them, which is the reason they cannot be dismissed as negligible.
implications.proposed_whitened_interval: whitening divides by the measurement standard deviation, which is large relative to R in these bins, so their contribution to the whitened discrepancy is small under the diagonal Poisson weighting. Under the multinomial weighting it is not small, because M^{-1/2} amplifies that direction. Which likelihood defines the covariance therefore changes the answer and must be frozen explicitly.
implications.this_is_not_a_support_mask: no threshold here selects components. Applying one would be a production mask, requiring the identical mask downstream and a recomputation of the affected production results first.

8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.statistic_under_test: candidate2_statistic, the proposed statistic with an unvalidated resampling heuristic

budgets.note: these roles are distinct and were mixed in an earlier version

estimator_pipeline_is_simulated.what_is_actually_built: D(h) is constructed directly from photon contributions with the correct analytic expectation. The plus and minus arms are not simulated separately; the w * xi / (2h) term is an effective central-difference noise surrogate, and in the reported run it is inert.
estimator_pipeline_is_simulated.why_rho_is_inert: rho enters only through amp * xi / (2h), and the calibration set the decorrelated amplitude to zero, so amp = 0 and the whole xi term vanishes. The value is retained as a DESCRIPTIVE statistic of the pilot. It is not re-tuned to activate it, because this simulation carries no coverage proof.

8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.signal_model: PHOTON CARRIED. Every step's estimate is built from the contributions of K ~ Poisson(lam) photons whose analytic expectation reproduces d0 + a2 h^2 + b4 h^4. When no photon contributes the estimate is EXACTLY zero at every step, so e2, e3 and d are all exactly zero for that bin. This is the rare-event mechanism the Bernoulli counterexample exploits.
8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.imperfect_crn_model: a decorrelated contribution enters as w * xi / (2h) with xi ZERO MEAN, which would produce growth of the noise toward small h and contributes nothing to the expectation. In the reported run its amplitude is zero, so this term is INERT and no claim is made that the simulation reproduces the pilot's adjacent-step correlation.

8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.no_infeasibility_is_claimed_without_a_pr: a target pair is called infeasible only when a necessary condition rules it out. Pairs the construction did not reach are UNDETERMINED and no conclusion is drawn from them.
8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.why_coverage_is_not_established: the committed Bernoulli counterexample shows the heuristic returning an upper value of zero and certifying equivalence at the margin whenever every replicate is zero, with measured coverage 0.26. On top of that this suite is not frozen, its photon layer is stylized, and its scenario count is small, so no interval from it can support registration.
8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.what_that_observation_is_not: it is not evidence that candidate 2 has zero power, that it is unusable, or that a valid bound would fail to yield a verdict. The rule exercised here is already known to be invalid, the margins are simulation parameters, the photon layer is stylized, the denominator comes from a simulated e2 rather than real transport, and the trial count is 200. A different valid construction can have different width and different power.
8_validation_of_the_proposed_statistic.reading: under this stylized generator, the rejected resampling heuristic and the illustrative margins, 0 equivalence decisions were observed in 200 zero-truth trials. Worst joint coverage 1.0000 on aggregate_boundary. Coverage is NOT established; see why_coverage_is_not_established.

8b_bernoulli_rare_event_counterexample.mechanism: with every observation zero the centered residuals and the resampled quantile are exactly zero, so the heuristic reports no uncertainty and certifies equivalence at the margin
8b_bernoulli_rare_event_counterexample.conclusion: candidate2_statistic is NOT a valid confidence bound. Coverage is far below nominal and the false-equivalence rate tracks (1-p)^n exactly.

componentwise_parametric.exact_statistic: max over retained components j of ( |mean_r (e3-e2)_rj| + c(n,k) se_j ) / max(|mean e2_j|, |mean e3_j|)
assumptions: per-component approximate normality of the replicate mean
no assumption on the dependence between components, which the Bonferroni component tolerates
componentwise_parametric.simultaneous_coverage_target: at least 0.95 over the retained components
componentwise_parametric.coverage_method: larger of a Bonferroni-corrected t at alpha/(2m) on n-1 degrees of freedom and a centered sign-flip studentized-max quantile
componentwise_parametric.scale_invariance: yes, verified behaviourally over 90 single-component rescalings
componentwise_parametric.compatible_with_all_120: no in practice. The denominator is each component's own derivative magnitude, and 43 of 120 bins expect under one measured photon, so the maximum is a noise artifact.
componentwise_parametric.treatment_of_low_count_bins: none. They enter with full weight and dominate.
componentwise_parametric.projected_transport_cost: 9.0 h at the pilot design; a grid at scale s raises the replicate requirement by about 1/s^2, so about 36 h at s = 0.5
unresolved_failure_modes: the near-discrete and low-count coverage shortfall, unguarded
cannot separate truncation bias from Monte Carlo uncertainty on its own scale
the h^2 coefficient is unidentified for 4 of 5 columns, the three thicknesses among them, so the grid cannot be retuned from this pilot

information_weighted.exact_statistic: a DUAL requirement, both legs computed by candidate2_statistic. Aggregate: ||W dbar|| / ||W e2bar||, with the denominator estimated from the same replicates. Component: max_j |dbar_j| / sqrt(C_jj) in PHYSICAL BIN coordinates. W is the frozen production whitening. The trace-subtracted quantity is a point estimate only and is NOT the statistic. No upper bound is proposed: the resampling heuristic that was tried is refuted by the committed Bernoulli counterexample.
assumptions: the covariance C is the frozen production measurement covariance, read from committed files and never re-estimated

any central limit behaviour must come from the independent photon and replicate contributions, NOT from the number of coordinates: a 120-dimensional whitened norm is a nonlinear function of correlated linear combinations and is not approximately normal merely because it has 120 coordinates. The proposed statistic therefore does not assume normality of the norm; the resampling heuristic that was tried instead is refuted by the Bernoulli counterexample, so NO calibrated construction currently exists for it
no inversion of the 120-dimensional discrepancy covariance, whose empirical rank is at most 5 at six replicates
information_weighted.simultaneous_coverage_target: at least 0.95 jointly over the aggregate and the component bound, with the level split between them in the frozen design
information_weighted.coverage_method: NONE YET. The sign-flip resampling heuristic that was tried fails the committed Bernoulli rare-event counterexample: with every replicate zero the resampled spread is zero, the heuristic reports zero uncertainty, and it certifies equivalence at the margin. Measured coverage 0.26 against a nominal 0.95. A valid construction has to be found before this candidate can carry a verdict.
information_weighted.scale_invariance: yes, and the weighting is anchored to a physical measurement scale rather than to the derivative's own magnitude
information_weighted.compatible_with_all_120: yes under the REGISTERED SUPPORT POLICY, which retains 120 of 120 for four columns and 90 of 120 for mus_slope. No component is dropped by a new mask, and each retained one is weighted by the information it carries in the published Fisher calculation. This is not the same claim as a literal 120 for every column, and the two must be reconciled before registration.
information_weighted.treatment_of_low_count_bins: weighted, not masked. Under diagonal Poisson their measurement noise is large relative to R so their whitened contribution is small. Under the multinomial primary likelihood M^{-1/2} amplifies them by about 1.24e+04, so the choice of likelihood changes the answer and must be frozen.
information_weighted.projected_transport_cost: 9.0 h at the pilot design. A finer grid is needed only if the bias-corrected whitened aggregate demands it, which cannot be decided until the margins are frozen.
unresolved_failure_modes: inherits the normality assumption; the near-discrete shortfall is not closed
the multinomial conditioning is the dominant numerical risk and is unaddressed
the grid remains unidentified for 4 of 5 columns, exactly as for candidate 1; changing the metric does not identify the h^2 coefficient
both margins are unset and cannot be set from these data
NO VALID COVERAGE CONSTRUCTION EXISTS for either leg. This is the blocking item.
the validation suite is not frozen and was assembled after seeing the pilot, so its pointwise intervals do not establish general coverage

photon_level_robust.exact_statistic: an empirical-Bernstein or bounded-difference upper bound on the mean per-photon paired contribution per bin, aggregated with the same whitening as candidate 2
assumptions: a DETERMINISTIC, executor-enforced almost-sure bound on the per-photon contribution. An observed maximum weight is NOT a valid range for empirical Bernstein: it is itself random and can be exceeded, so using it invalidates the bound. Either the executor enforces a cap, or a self-normalized or heavy-tail construction is used instead
no distributional assumption beyond that bound
photon_level_robust.simultaneous_coverage_target: at least 0.95, held without a normality assumption
photon_level_robust.coverage_method: concentration, so coverage is by construction rather than by simulation; the simulation would verify the implementation
photon_level_robust.scale_invariance: yes, the bound is on standardized per-photon quantities
photon_level_robust.compatible_with_all_120: not at the current budget. 43 bins expect under one measured photon, where a valid concentration bound is too wide to be informative. This is a budget statement, not an impossibility result: more photons or more independent replicates tighten a valid bound, and no general impossibility is claimed.
photon_level_robust.treatment_of_low_count_bins: the bound is too wide to be informative there at the current budget, which is honest but leaves those components unadjudicated until the budget rises
required_new_executor_outputs: per bin, the sum of per-photon paired differences
per bin, the sum of their squares, for the empirical variance
per bin, a DETERMINISTIC cap on the per-photon difference, enforced by the executor rather than observed, for the range term
per bin, the sum of weights and the sum of squared weights, for n_eff = (sum w)^2 / sum w^2
photon_level_robust.projected_transport_cost: 9.0 h unchanged, plus executor work and a coverage study. Four extra scalar accumulators per bin per wavelength, inside the existing scatter-add.
unresolved_failure_modes: moving-boundary events make the range term O(the largest single photon weight), which is loosest exactly where few photons contribute
the sub-one-photon bins stay unadjudicated unless a mask is introduced, and a mask requires identical downstream application plus recomputation of the production results it changes
